Slack sales notices

Send stage moves, wins, due work, internal handoffs and dashboard-ready notices. Dashboard-ready notices contain only the event kind and an authenticated Orbit link; no dashboard name, figure, count or attachment. Restricted details and person names are withheld; channels get a generic notice and authenticated link. Notes, calls, handoff text, contact details and amounts stay in Orbit.

Before connecting Slack

Bot permissions: chat:write — Post allowed-field notices and delete the bot’s messages. channels:read — Check public channel membership and safety. groups:read for private channels only — Check private channel membership and safety. users:read — Receive user_change deactivation events and check mapped personal recipients. im:write for optional personal mentions — Open a direct message for an explicitly opted-in personal mention. im:read for optional personal mentions — Verify the direct message still belongs to the mapped personal recipient before delivery. Never request users:read.email; profile email is not read.

Allowed channel fields: Event kind, Authenticated Orbit link, Deal or company display name, Previous stage, New stage, Owner display name, Due date, Task type, Task priority. Person names and restricted details are withheld; private records get only event kind and the authenticated link.

Bot token and app signing secret stay installation-local, encrypted using AES-GCM with the installation encryption key; neither is read back or exported.

Set the Interactivity Request URL to http://127.0.0.1:8788/api/v1/slack/actions and the Events Request URL to http://127.0.0.1:8788/api/v1/slack/events. Both require Slack timestamp and HMAC-SHA256 signature. Subscribe to user_change with users:read to revoke deactivated user mappings.

Membership can change between checks. A newly linked organization may see channel history. Membership is checked before each post; signed safety events suspend routing until the owner confirms it again. Disconnect pauses routing and removes credentials; reconnect sends no old notice and permits no old action.

Slack account and plan requirements remain with Slack; Orbit does not buy a plan or authorize spending.

Unresolved setup · notices paused

The installation owner manages Slack channels and their audiences. Explicit Slack user IDs map to active Orbit operators; email never determines identity. Mappings bind the Slack team, enterprise, app and user, and need fresh confirmation after restore or access changes. Slack actions acknowledge a notice or create an internal task. Customer mail always needs its separate Orbit review.

How to set this up

The installation owner connects a Slack app for this workspace. Use your hosted Orbit’s public HTTPS address for callbacks; Slack cannot reach localhost.

Open Your Apps in Slack
(opens in a new tab)
, choose Create New App › From scratch, name it Orbit, select your workspace and choose Create App. Ask a workspace administrator to approve installation if required.
Open OAuth & Permissions › Bot Token Scopes › Add an OAuth Scope. Add chat:write to post and delete bot notices, channels:read to check public channels, and groups:read if using private channels. Add users:read for user-change safety events and mapped personal recipient checks. For opted-in personal mentions, also add im:write to open the direct message and im:read to verify its recipient before delivery.
On that page choose Install to Workspace (or Install to Team) and Allow. Copy the Bot User OAuth Token into Orbit’s Bot token field. Under Basic Information › App Credentials, reveal Signing Secret and paste it into Slack app signing secret. Choose Verify and connect Slack here before enabling Events, so Orbit can answer Slack’s URL check.
In Slack’s Interactivity & Shortcuts, turn Interactivity on, set Request URL to the address below, and save. In Event Subscriptions, turn Enable Events on and use the second address as Request URL.
http://127.0.0.1:8788/api/v1/slack/actions
Copy
http://127.0.0.1:8788/api/v1/slack/events
Copy
Under Subscribe to bot events, add user_change, channel_shared, channel_unshared, channel_archive, group_archive, channel_left, member_left_channel, app_uninstalled and tokens_revoked. Save changes and reinstall the app if Slack requests updated permissions.
In Slack, invite the app to each internal channel with /invite @Orbit (use your app’s name). Back here choose Load member channels or Load private member channels, choose a channel and its event types. Shared and external channels are refused. After a permitted notice is accepted, use Map Slack identities for notice buttons.
